en: Colorized panoramic view of a small town in a mountain valley labeled "TOLMIN." A white church with a tall bell tower stands near the center, with clustered houses, fields, and forested hills; a river is visible in the background. The reverse shows handwritten message and address, an Austrian 5-heller green stamp with a Tolmin postmark, and a purple library stamp; destination appears to be Trieste.
